reply.summary: Oneortor is an eyeless, hairless envoy made of glossy green slime, who oozes through formal ceremonies and leaves a shining trail on every marble floor. Oneortor wants nothing more than a quiet household and a long soak.

feats.scene: Oneortor slaps a rude courtier with a wet pseudopod hard enough to spin him around.
Oneortor is squashed flat under a toppled banquet table and simply reflows into shape.

reply.summary: Llesuron is a green-skinned gremlin from deep space with black eyes and a mop of yellow hair, who stows away in cargo holds and befriends lonely dockworkers. Llesuron drifts a little above the ground when excited and loves shiny bolts.

feats.scene: Llesuron yanks a hull panel off a shuttle to get at the wiring inside.
Llesuron tumbles out of an airlock and bounces off a landing strut unharmed.

reply.summary: Iseosau is a limbless, scaled parasite that rides inside a hollow armoured shell until it finds prey, then lashes out with claws and fangs and siphons vigour through skin contact. Iseosau grows stronger with every life it drains.

feats.scene: Iseosau smashes out of its shell and drives claws through a steel bulkhead into a guard.
Iseosau tumbles down a furnace shaft into a bed of flames and keeps clinging to its victim.

reply.summary: Monamasi is a cheerful, hairless, black-eyed glutton who wears a greedy-coloured ring and raids pantries for fun. Monamasi weaves glowing constructs, wraps itself in a shield and soars off with a stolen cheese roll.

feats.scene: Monamasi launches a glowing mallet construct that flattens a kitchen wall.
Monamasi shrugs off a collapsing cupboard tower behind a shimmering ring shield.

reply.summary: Autisni is one of seven alien parasites that crave spinal fluid and wear borrowed human faces. Autisni is hard to hurt, never tires and hits like a falling truck, and plants its power in unwilling hosts.

feats.scene: Autisni backhands a parked van across a lot.
Autisni takes a full volley of rifle fire at close range and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Terurn is a parasite from an alien brood that gifts strange powers to chosen hosts, later reduced to a ring name on a wrestling card. Terurn's trophy head sits in a dusty display case, and the rest of the brawler keeps bragging.

feats.scene: Terurn slams a rival through the ring floor with a body drop.
Terurn is flattened by a steel-armed throat strike and grins afterwards.

reply.summary: Riaonere is a brown-haired woman drawn out of a living street's imagination, a researcher in a story who became real. Riaonere gives up her life to stop a dangerous former spouse, bursting into a ball of light.

feats.scene: Riaonere fires a rocket-propelled capsule skyward from a rooftop launcher she built herself.
Riaonere staggers but stays upright after a shot lands in her back.

reply.summary: Corvaulla is a blue, bald vessel holding the hopes of countless vanished peoples, who guards a shadowy tower. Corvaulla projects bright energy, raises barriers and swallows spirits to feed the hoard inside.

feats.scene: Corvaulla unleashes a blast that hollows out a parking structure.
Corvaulla stands unmoved in a barrier of pale light as a ceiling falls.

reply.summary: Sormiam is a red-eyed, black-haired woman who bends gravity to float and shove objects, and who trusts a voice from an implant in her head. Sormiam's schemes are shaped by the chatter in her skull.

feats.scene: Sormiam flings a delivery truck across an intersection with a gravity pulse.
Sormiam climbs out of a wrecked sedan with only bruises.

reply.summary: Sorau is a black-haired rogue who lurks in a hidden dimension, styled after an old picture of a nameless burglar. Sorau steals what he can carry and talks his way out of the rest.

feats.scene: Sorau cracks a vault door with a lucky kick.
Sorau shrugs off a fall from a low balcony into a hedge.

reply.summary: Oralu is a white-haired sorceress from a far-future realm, servant to a master of time who rewrote history with a self-sacrificing spell. Oralu later cast herself in her master's seat and sent an enemy across the centuries.

feats.scene: Oralu casts a rite that spends her own life and rewinds the whole age.
Oralu endures a barrage of sorcerous bolts behind a ward of pale fire.

reply.summary: Valonsan is a yellow-eyed, bald demon with an endless appetite, one of many brothers and a bully at family feasts. Valonsan is easily goaded into brawling with his own kin.

feats.scene: Valonsan swings a stone table into a sibling and shatters it.
Valonsan is mobbed by his brothers and brushes them off.

reply.summary: Teamist is a red-eyed, bulky half-demon who instantly drains the vitality of those he touches, leaving victims as bones and skin. Teamist was empowered by his dark parent to hunt his half-sister's friends.

feats.scene: Teamist siphons the strength out of two warriors in a single grab.
Teamist is struck with a burst of heroic force and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Callenan is a teenage caveman dragged forward through time, who learns a new language, gets psychic counselling and ends up repairing engines for a living. Callenan grunts his own name as his main word.

feats.scene: Callenan hurls a boulder-sized rock at a rival over a cliff edge.
Callenan tumbles down a cliff face and survives to be rescued.

reply.summary: Naleo is a thoughtful hunter from the stone age with deep knowledge of poetry and philosophy, who asks his prey for forgiveness before the kill. Naleo is stronger than a normal person and takes heavy blows.

feats.scene: Naleo knocks a larger fighter flat with one overhand strike.
Naleo absorbs a blow from a super-strong opponent and barely flinches.

reply.summary: Llecis is a bald crook who hides his identity and picks fights with a masked manhunter. Llecis relies on cunning and ordinary tools and has no supernatural gifts.

feats.scene: Llecis swings a crowbar into a window frame and splinters it.
Llecis takes a fist to the jaw and stays standing.

reply.summary: Cilriaces is a yellow-eyed, bald immortal who calls himself a source of endless radiance, filtering sunbeams through rare metal to amplify his gifts. Cilriaces empowers street kids and builds a reactor to test his heir.

feats.scene: Cilriaces rigs a reactor whose blast would level a block of tenements.
Cilriaces taunts his captors while holding a bullet wound that does not kill him.

reply.summary: Tintau is the maker of every existing thing and the most powerful being there is, seldom seen and only mentioned in tremors of fear. Tintau cast out the proudest of the angels after a rebellion and looks on from a distant realm.

feats.scene: Tintau speaks the whole of creation into being from nothing.
Tintau stands untouched while a rebel host of angels hurls everything at the throne.

reply.summary: Sauloreon is an ancient space-dwelling organism that once steered young matter into a ball and parked it near the sun. Sauloreon returned to scrub the world of its infesting people with spores, until a team entered its bloodstream and killed it.

feats.scene: Sauloreon pulls loose rubble together with its mind into a perfect sphere.
Sauloreon survives the crash of a wandering world into its freshly made ball.

reply.summary: Cinorovor is a grey-skinned, green-eyed ring bearer with an unbending will, last of a patrol sent against a conqueror of stars. Cinorovor gave his life to shield natives and a team of heroes.

feats.scene: Cinorovor fires a sustained beam that cracks the conqueror's warship in half.
Cinorovor holds a glowing barrier against a barrage until the ring runs dry.

reply.summary: Reall is an ancient deity with white eyes who fled a ruined divine homeland and was entombed in molten stone, leaving only a face. Reall's worshippers carved a staff that channelled his power into a mortal who went mad.

feats.scene: Reall sends a surge through the staff that levels a mountain ridge.
Reall survives being buried in molten rock for ages.

reply.summary: Sioluror is a stretchy, black-eyed metal robot, cheerful and always ready to serve, who directs his teammates in the field. Sioluror was built by an inventor in a laboratory and loves taking charge.

feats.scene: Sioluror stretches an arm across a room and slaps a switch.
Sioluror is flattened by a falling crate and springs back to shape.

reply.summary: Veoeo is a liquid-metal robot who can mould his body into almost any form and acts as the calm, methodical leader of a team of six metallic siblings. Veoeo keeps the peace between his quarrelsome brothers and sisters, and resists most chemicals.

feats.scene: Veoeo stretches into a giant hammer and brings it down on a monster.
Veoeo is crushed by a hydraulic press and reforms from a puddle.

reply.summary: Rilnusnin is a green-eyed android of soft, conductive metal, leader of a group of living-metal robots, who runs only while a small core device stays whole. Rilnusnin bends, reshapes and punches well above human limits.

feats.scene: Rilnusnin hardens a fist into a mallet and drives a hole through a concrete pillar.
Rilnusnin stands in a collapsing tower and walks out as the dust clears.

reply.summary: Iatalni is a dark-haired time traveller descended from heroes of the future, who pilots a cramped craft that is bigger outside than in, driven by an ancient hourglass relic. Iatalni helps speedsters mend temporal damage across the ages.

feats.scene: Iatalni seals a rip in time over a laboratory with her ship's engine surge.
Iatalni takes a hail of stun discs and shakes it off after a short rest.

reply.summary: Carsiuer is a brown-eyed criminal from the east who hypnotises a kidnapped girl into servitude and extorts a weapons maker. Carsiuer is bested by a diner customer who finds a hidden tunnel and rings a gong.

feats.scene: Carsiuer shoves a hostage's guard down a flight of stairs.
Carsiuer is knocked out by a single hard blow to the head.

reply.summary: Neltoror is a blond, bigoted soldier who wears a winged harness that lets him fly fast and silently. Neltoror fought under a banner of hate and was coerced into a squad of expendable convicts.

feats.scene: Neltoror dives in silence and rams a sentry off a rooftop.
Neltoror streaks across a night sky over the harbour in his harness.

reply.summary: Lanvisa is a gold-skinned, gold-eyed demon general, imprisoned in a gourd and freed to possess a human, whose hunger for vital essence cannot be sated. Lanvisa serves a flaming master and craves a hero's soul.

feats.scene: Lanvisa hurls a bolt of heat that collapses an auction hall roof.
Lanvisa laughs through a barrage of blows inside a cracked gourd.

reply.summary: Miaianliu is a yellow invader who grows to giant size, flies on great wings and rakes with claws. Miaianliu transforms victims into winged slaves and shrieks with a punishing sonic scream, but loses his hold once knocked out.

feats.scene: Miaianliu screams and shatters every pane in a tower.
Miaianliu absorbs a beam from a cosmic ring and the glow slides off its yellow hide.

reply.summary: Amlla is a blond servant of a hidden master who spins shining webs from his hands, a villain created from a reader's idea. Amlla is an enemy of a hero who switches forms by dial.

feats.scene: Amlla casts a golden net across an alley to trap two pursuers.
Amlla tumbles from a fire escape into a dumpster and gets up.

reply.summary: Rnnal is a green-eyed, blond villainess who moves her long hair with her mind and is infatuated with a boy hero she wants as a royal match. Rnnal joined a gang of misfits at the same time as a hulking newcomer.

feats.scene: Rnnal whips her hair around a lamppost and rips it out of the pavement.
Rnnal is tossed against a wall and rolls up laughing.

reply.summary: Anlen is a widowed emperor who rules a harsh realm with his daughter at his side. Anlen relies on soldiers, spies and ruthless decree rather than any magical gift.

feats.scene: Anlen strikes a kneeling minister across the face with a gloved hand.
Anlen takes a fall from the throne steps and stands without a word.

reply.summary: Lluest is a purple-skinned demon spawn, born into a tainted sea as a mindless, uncontrollable beast and unwelcome to his own father. Lluest's birth was so ghastly that onlookers were sickened.

feats.scene: Lluest rips through a castle gate in a frenzy.
Lluest wades through a storm of infernal flame and does not slow.

reply.summary: Mevos is a towering warrior of ancient times who fights with sword and thrown spear, rides a horse and cows opponents with his size. Mevos is humbled in single combat by a young challenger, and his legend inspires copycats centuries later.

feats.scene: Mevos hurls a spear that pins a shield to a tree.
Mevos shrugs off a charging soldier and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Niutiutia is a bald, white-eyed flood deity, built in secret from stolen shape-shifting technology to help seize a nation. Niutiutia was a decoy and was sentenced to die by an emperor's decree.

feats.scene: Niutiutia calls a torrent that drowns a harbour district.
Niutiutia stands in a hail of gunfire and walks forward.

reply.summary: Eoanunto is a hulking champion of a bright parallel realm, a homage to cheerful comic strongmen. Eoanunto lifts and punches far beyond a normal frame, defending a colourful metropolis.

feats.scene: Eoanunto lifts a bus overhead and sets it down gently.
Eoanunto stands firm as a cannon shell bursts against his chest.

reply.summary: Sonnumse is a black-haired soldier of fortune who lost an eye, served in a foreign legion and takes contract work in many wars. Sonnumse trusts his rifle and his luck.

feats.scene: Sonnumse lobs a grenade through a bunker slit.
Sonnumse rolls through a shell crater and rises with shrapnel scratches.

reply.summary: Iaenunes is a blond, black-eyed television host who berates masked heroes on air, twisting guests' answers and chasing ratings. Iaenunes loses viewers when the heroes save the world from a menace.

feats.scene: Iaenunes slams a rolled script on his desk to silence a guest.
Iaenunes slips off a studio stage and gets up still smiling.

reply.summary: Liust is a grey-haired radio host who spreads bitter opinions on the airwaves until a dark overlord possesses him. Liust turns against vigilantes, is photographed in disgrace and vanishes into smoke when shot by archery.

feats.scene: Liust knocks a microphone stand into a reporter's face.
Liust is pinned by arrows and dissolves into smoke.

reply.summary: Anannau is a masked brute with a snaking mane that grips and strangles, a hulking bruiser in a gang of extremists. Anannau is strong and tough, and a pastiche of a rival publisher's villain.

feats.scene: Anannau ties a bus to a lamppost with his hair and hauls it free.
Anannau tanks a rocket and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Elatuces is a red-haired alien thug with cybernetic upgrades and a living mane, a refugee from a nuclear-ravaged world who seized a small nation. Elatuces fell through a cracked floor after a sonic scream.

feats.scene: Elatuces hurls a hunk of masonry through a rooftop door.
Elatuces falls several storeys into rubble and lives.

reply.summary: Tuvalli is a giant from an unknown dimension with snakes for hair, who turns anyone meeting his eyes to stone and fights with great strength. Tuvalli menaces a stage magician from beyond the veil.

feats.scene: Tuvalli turns a charging bull to stone with a single stare.
Tuvalli walks off a hail of thrown boulders.

reply.summary: Serser is a red-skinned, black-eyed fear-powered soldier who commands a corps ring and a charging battery in a remote sector of space. Serser dies in his first outing against a heroic rival.

feats.scene: Serser fires a ring beam through a cruiser's hull.
Serser withstands a glancing hit on his ring-shield.

reply.summary: Tisto is a black-haired party-loving student turned into a mindless ape-man by a tampered serum. Tisto grows fangs and heavy muscle, then reverts to normal after a rough defeat.

feats.scene: Tisto smashes a dormitory door off its hinges.
Tisto is thrown into a wall and only grunts.

reply.summary: Veirn is a talking ape with fangs and brown eyes, who trades high-tech arms to masked villains before trying to go straight in a seaside city. Veirn insists he is framed for crimes he never committed.

feats.scene: Veirn flips a crate of rifles over a counter at a pursuer.
Veirn shakes off a rooftop tumble after being grabbed.

reply.summary: Llete is a yellow-eyed ape with a razor mind, who reads thoughts, bends wills and hurls psychic blasts, and wears a helmet to focus his gift. Llete is nimble, strong and an organiser of villains.

feats.scene: Llete flings a psychic blast that caves in a van door.
Llete takes a hard blow from a masked hero and stays composed.

reply.summary: Nesauvar is a huge grey-eyed ape-king of a hidden jungle city, a psychic genius who once seized a human's body and now commands armies of lesser apes. Nesauvar lives to humble a swift hero.

feats.scene: Nesauvar seizes control of a warden's mind and walks him out of prison.
Nesauvar withstands a fusillade of tranquiliser darts.

reply.summary: Nison is a yellow-eyed ape-king who devours brains for knowledge, steals the pace of a speed field and travels across time, hungry for secrets. Nison is killed to stop him from tearing the speed field apart.

feats.scene: Nison rips open the speed field with a stolen burst and fractures it.
Nison blurs through a laboratory faster than sound.

reply.summary: Lentinu is a black-haired ape with great strength and a gift for controlling minds, one of dozens of villains chasing two heroes after a rival's death. Lentinu is more brute than schemer in this version.

feats.scene: Lentinu uproots a street sign and swings it at a rooftop pursuer.
Lentinu is flung through a billboard and keeps charging.

reply.summary: Orrnral is a black-haired fanged ape and villain who fights in a great city battle in the future, the day powers fade from many heroes and rogues. Orrnral is strong beyond a human and fights bare-handed.

feats.scene: Orrnral throws a hero through a shop window.
Orrnral staggers after a fall yet grips a ledge.
